===== inline marks and escaping =====
plain [b]bold[/b] [i]italic[/i] [u]under[/u] [del]strike[/del] [code]code[/code] [bracket] ok


===== link and textStyle =====
[url=https://example.com/page]visit [/url][url]https://example.com[/url] [color=#ff0000]red[/color][size=150%] big[/size]


===== heading blockquote lists code =====
[b][size=120%]Title[/size][/b]

intro

[quote]quote text[/quote]

[list]
[*]a
[*]b
[/list]

[list=1]
[*]1
[/list]

[code=ts]const x = 1[/code]

==========

===== table with header and spans =====
[table]
[tr][td][b]H1[/b][/td][td][b]H2[/b][/td][td][b]H3[/b][/td][/tr]
[tr][td colspan=2]wide[/td][td]c2[/td][/tr]
[/table]

===== link href with bracket is escaped in attribute position =====
[url=https://example.com/a%5Db]click[/url]


===== code block content with brackets and terminator passes through raw =====
[code=ts]if (a[0]) { [/code] }[/code]


===== image caption with brackets passes through raw =====
[img]https://img.nightingalesilence.com/content/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002.png[/img]
[b]my [cat][/b]


===== unknown mark yields warning and keeps text =====
super

[b]g cap[/b]
